radiusSource: Radius 1.08 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Di Maio et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4602.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.270D/abstract): 751,356 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
